title: sox-memory (graph memory subsystem)
description: Use this when you want the full sox-memory graph-memory subsystem installed in one command — expands to memory-server (MCP tools, stdio, with in-process deterministic batch enrichment), memory-flush (SessionEnd hook), memory-cli (store lifecycle commands), and memory-usage (how-to skill). Fully deterministic; zero LLM calls; no provider required.

title: Memory CLI
description: Use this when you need to manage the sox-memory store from the shell — provides memory init|status|list|registry subcommands for store lifecycle, scope selection, and registry inspection. Fully deterministic; zero LLM calls.

title: Memory Session Flush
description: Use this when you need session memory durably persisted at conversation end and scope promotions reviewed — binds SessionEnd (persists working memory, enqueues episodes, nudges memoryd) and ScopePromotionProposed (runs promotion approval policy). Deterministic; zero LLM calls.

title: Agent Memory Server
description: Use this when an agent needs durable, searchable memory across sessions — exposes 23 memory_* tools over a single-file SQLite graph store with hybrid recall (vec+BM25+temporal, <50ms, zero LLM), write-enqueue, session state, community lookup, bi-temporal invalidation, atomic claims, and an observable global re-cluster.

title: Using the soxe memory system
description: Use when an agent should recall prior knowledge or store durable findings in the soxe graph-memory system via the memory_* MCP tools (memory_recall / memory_write / memory_search_entities / memory_invalidate).

title: soxe CLI
description: LLM extension ecosystem CLI — extension #0 (D1/D2 self-hosting)
